levels.surface: سعد بن عبد الله بن أبي خلف

notes: The text carries two readings of one name, «الْحُسَيْنُ [الْحَسَنُ]»; the surface keeps the text as written, the bracket is an editor's alternative
Muhammad b. Ali is written after «عن», so he is a narrator; the words that follow are his saying
Father and group of shaykhs co-transmit in one level (rule 2)
